name: Chili-Spiced Pumpkin Soup with Pork, Cauliflower, Cilantro & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ limes

instructions.primary_message: Separate each cauliflower into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; place in a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the cauliflower (reserving the rest for serving).
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add pork and spices. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1.02 kg lean ground pork
1 tbsp chili powder
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, peel, halve, and small dice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the cauliflower and cilantro.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: When the pork is done, add veggies to the pot and cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 4-5 minutes.

Add broth and pumpkin to the pot; stir to combine and bring the soup to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the cauliflower is soft, 10-15 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2129 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (398 ml) cans pure pumpkin purée

instructions.primary_message: When the soup is done, juice limes into the pot, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and sprinkle with reserved cilantro. Enjoy!
